title: Senior Technical Project Manager
description:
Monitor and manage Website, Android and iOS application development. Independently review software vendor performance, project milestones and deliverables. Verify development progress through working demos, testing and documented evidence. Review APIs, database architecture, backend integrations and cloud infrastructure. Ensure software quality, security, scalability and proper technical documentation. Track bugs, development issues, timelines and project risks. Coordinate source code handover, database access and deployment readiness. Support future AI Calling, AI Chatbot, CRM and AI-based land matching integrations. Prepare weekly progress reports and explain technical matters clearly to management.

Key Skills: Web development,Application,DBMS,Agile methodology,Software development,AWS,Application development,Management
